…with the Rosenheim Plate for our win in the Eastern Division, plus a brand new trophy for winning the Final, news-hound Pete Mulholland couldn't help commenting, " ... thirty years before Belgrave could win it ... and it's taken a woman to bring it off!" Not only did we win it - but it was a record…
All credit to those who helped in that climate, including Pete Mulholland of Hercules Wimbledon who assisted Alan Mead with the results after he had started hallucinating on tea and fruit cake.

But with the aid of H/W's good old Pete Mulholland even this hiccough was overcome in time to present the prizes for the fastest laps. The police had been asked to cone off a large section of The Causeway which was to be used as the takeover area but surprisingly, come Saturday morning, this had not been done.
Thanks to Charlie Manning and Lionel Mann who have provided some of the more obscure road running results and to Peter Mulholland for helping with the area Track & Field results.
